application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of part first floor side and rear extension with erection of a detached rear outbuilding and conversion of an existing garage into a habitable room to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL 06 Rev. A, PL 05, PL 04, PL 03, PL 02 Rev. A, PL 01 Rev. A - received 11th January 2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.
Reason: To protect the character of the locality, to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to prevent unacceptable disturbance to neighbours.
